complete_payload_scope: All parent/media selected complete YAMLs and exact preimages were individually read, including historical fields. Later generic/Polypeptone/reference successors require their own exact read receipt.
existing_component_owner_scope: 28 matching existing native owners inspected for identity/mapping/chemistry/supplied-form fields; Agar and Starch complete files read. This is not 28 whole-owner scientific approvals.
frozen_source_scope: Two Peptone original rows, Soy ingredient75 record and source/negative-hold metadata. All 200 Soy quarantine associations are retained byte-for-byte, not individually freshly approved. Four media caption source scopes are retained with their exact earlier evidence; no claim to a fresh review of hundreds of recipes.
attribution: Earlier primary and skeptical authors retain their actual work. Current fresh source checks supplement only the declared scopes; unchanged historical interpretations are not silently reauthored.
scope_limit: Hashes document exact read inputs and preserved reuse, not chemical correctness by themselves. Source acquisition times remain the actual original values; current review time is distinct.
